title: Free cloud inference for small developers
new_cost: $0 cloud API fees for Apple Foundation Models on Private Cloud Compute, for Small Business Program members under 2M lifetime downloads
note: Inverts the consumer AI margin trap entirely. Also skips the new third-party AI consent prompt, because nothing leaves Apple's stack.

title: Full-scale LLMs run locally on phone hardware
new_cost: zero marginal cost, offline, private; Core AI framework plus a vision-capable on-device model
note: Android equivalent: ML Kit GenAI on Gemini Nano via AICore, free and hardware-accelerated.

title: Frontier-class text inference collapsed in price
note: A 99.7% reduction in three years. Any app needing under $1 of model cost per user-month is now viable.

title: Real-time voice conversation at consumer prices
new_cost: $0.005-$0.018 per minute on cheap stacks, up to $0.091 on flagship speech-to-speech
note: A 13x spread. Ten minutes a day costs about $3.45 per user monthly on the cheap stack and $15-$27 on the expensive one. Model choice is the business model.

title: Million-token context at a flat price with cached input
old_cost: a retrieval pipeline and a vector database
new_cost: 1M-token context at flat pricing, cached input at roughly a 90% discount
note: Personal-memory products no longer need retrieval infrastructure. Caution: introductory rates end 2026-12-31.

title: Generated video at feature prices
new_cost: $0.03 per second; a five-second clip costs $0.15-$0.25
note: But video-native consumer products remain the one failure class 2026 has NOT dissolved. Sora burned about $1M a day against $2.1M lifetime in-app revenue and was discontinued.

title: Age assurance as an operating system call
old_cost: a vendor contract and a compliance project
new_cost: Apple Declared Age Range API and Google Play Age Signals API, free
note: Makes kids' and teen apps buildable by one person. Mandatory in Texas from 2026-01-01 and Utah from 2026-07-01, so it is a moat as well as a gate.

title: Smart glasses opened to third-party developers
new_cost: Meta Ray-Ban Display developer access with an official HTML/CSS/JS path plus native SDKs and Neural Band input
note: Near-zero installed competition, and no public data on installed base or revenue. A reasoned bet, not a data-backed one.

title: US app payments at zero platform commission
new_cost: 0% on external payment links from a US app, since May 2025
note: Time-limited arbitrage. Certiorari was granted 2026-06-30 and a cost-based fee could return in 2027. 41% of top-tier apps take web revenue against 1.3% of hobby apps.
